description: Prompt for estimating a user story's story points while the harness's refinement refines it, saying when it is too large for one ticket and goes to Split (ASS-252)

points.description: The story's points, on the project's scale (project:story-point-scale), as written to the ticket; null for a bug or a spike, which get none

too-large.description: True when the story is bigger than the scale's top (5): too large for one ticket, so Split proposes smaller ones

summary.description: One line: why this many points
